title: AcceptRepoInviteToGithub
description: setup-project: the path parameter of PATCH /user/repository_invitations/{invitation_id}, which accepts a pending invitation. The request has no body. The token goes in the Authorization header with Accept: application/vnd.github+json and X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28.

invitation_id.description: The invitation's id, from the invitations list.
